FN-4UXBU33-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 165
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/16/2026
Senate Bill 165 as introduced would increase existing qualification fees for candidates in Class
4 municipalities from a minimum of $10 to a maximum of $50 for all candidates, to the amount
of $500 for mayoral candidates and the amount of $250 for candidates for city councils and
municipal boards of education. This would increase receipts to Class 4 municipalities by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the new fee amounts and the amount of
the qualification fees currently set by ordinance for respective municipalities.
Page 1

FN-4UXBU33-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 165
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/09/2026
Senate Bill 165 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to Class 4 municipalities by an
undetermined amount dependent on the difference in 1) the current filing fees set by the
governing body, up to $50, as provided by the current law; and 2) the qualifying fees for
candidates for council member and municipal board of education member of $250 and $500 for
mayor.
